everlandPlanner.title: When should you visit Everland?
everlandPlanner.intro: Compare the weather and expected crowd levels before choosing a day.
everlandPlanner.caution: The forecast calls for caution outdoors. Check the latest forecast and official operating notices.
everlandPlanner.scoreHelp: A comparison score combining weather and calendar assumptions, not satisfaction or predictive accuracy.

reasons.dry: Less than 0.5 mm of rain is expected during the comparison window.
reasons.lightRain: Light rain is forecast. Bring a raincoat.
reasons.rain: Rain may affect outdoor activities and rides.
reasons.comfortable: Daytime temperatures of 14–27°C are relatively comfortable outdoors.
reasons.cold: Some daytime periods are below 14°C. Bring an extra layer.
reasons.hot: Daytime temperatures exceed 27°C. Prepare for heat.
reasons.holiday: A public holiday is assumed to be busier than a normal weekday.
reasons.weekend: Weekends are assumed to be busier than weekdays.
reasons.friday: Fridays are assumed to be busier than other weekdays.
reasons.weekday: Monday–Thursday is assumed to be quieter than weekends.
reasons.wind: Windy periods are forecast. Check official ride notices.
reasons.indoor: An indoor visit reduces rain, temperature and wind penalties. Outdoor ride operation is not guaranteed.

everlandPlanner.dateListIntro: Select a day for weather periods and the reasoning behind its score.
everlandPlanner.visitWindow: We compare 10:00–18:00 KST. Check official opening and closing times.
everlandPlanner.coarse: This date includes 6–12 hour forecast intervals; fine hourly differences are unavailable.
everlandPlanner.prorated: Rain totals are apportioned by the overlap between forecast intervals and the visit window, not exact timing or probability.
everlandPlanner.noDataHelp: A fresh forecast with at least six daytime hours is unavailable. We do not show recommendation scores until data is sufficient.
everlandPlanner.noScope: No weekend or holiday has sufficient forecast data. Try including weekdays.
everlandPlanner.timezone: All dates and times use Korea Standard Time (KST).
everlandPlanner.weatherSourceDetail: Global numerical forecasts at Everland, Yongin (37.294, 127.204), checked about hourly. Not a substitute for KMA warnings or on-site observations.
everlandPlanner.methodology: Weather scores use temperature, precipitation and wind during the visit window. Crowds are estimated from weekdays and public holidays. Weather/calendar weights are 70/30 for a relaxed visit, 85/15 with children and 80/20 for rides. Rain, cold, wind and thunderstorms lower scores.
everlandPlanner.limitations: Crowds currently use preliminary calendar rules, without attendance, events, group bookings, school breaks or reservation data. Ride waits are collected separately and do not yet power a validated crowd prediction model.
everlandPlanner.safetyRule: At least 8 mm rain, 9 m/s wind, freezing or 33°C+ temperatures, or a thunderstorm signal caps suitability at 45 points. These are ToolHub comparison rules, not ride closure thresholds.
everlandPlanner.staleRule: Recommendations stop when forecast issue or fetch time is over 24 hours old. Recheck before travelling, especially for distant dates.
everlandPlanner.independent: An independent ToolHub reference service, not an official Everland service.

faq.q: Which weekday is best for Everland?
faq.a: With other conditions equal, compare Monday to Thursday first. Holidays, events and group visits can change this pattern. This page combines current forecasts with an explanation for each date.

faq.q: Is a rainy day better because it is quieter?
faq.a: We do not assume rain makes the park quieter. Rain reduces visit suitability because it may affect outdoor activities and ride operations.

faq.q: Do recommendations change for children or rides?
faq.a: The family profile puts more weight on weather and comfortable temperatures. The ride profile penalizes rain more heavily. After choosing a date, use the map to check ride locations and current operating status.
No. They are relative estimates based on weekdays and public holidays, not validated attendance or waiting-time predictions.

faq.q: How far ahead can I compare?
faq.a: Dates with sufficient daytime coverage within MET Norway’s approximately nine-day forecast. Dates five or more days away are marked as tentative.

everlandPlanner.mapIntro: Once you choose a date, find the rides you want to visit on the guide map.
everlandPlanner.mapFrame: Everland guide map and ride waits
everlandPlanner.mapVersion: Map: Everland’s published 2023 guide. Facilities and names may have changed. Only matched locations are shown.
everlandPlanner.mapCaption: Locations on this illustrated guide are not walking directions or exact entrances.
everlandPlanner.sameBest: This date has the highest comparison score for your preferences.
everlandPlanner.staticIntro: Check live forecasts to compare visit dates using weekday/holiday assumptions, rain, temperature and wind. Find rides on the guide map.
everlandPlanner.todayPartial: Today is excluded from full-day recommendations when earlier forecast periods are missing.
everlandPlanner.dateDescription: Compare daytime temperature, rain, wind, calendar-based crowds and the reasons for visiting Everland on {date}.
everlandPlanner.areaNote: Temperatures, rain and wind are outdoor forecasts. Indoor visits reduce weather penalties and weight, but travel risks and operating restrictions still apply.

calendar.title: Everland crowd calendar
calendar.intro: Expected crowds, operating hours, forecast scores and measured average waits for past days, all on one calendar.
calendar.metaDescription: Everland {year}-{month} calendar with expected crowds, operating hours and weather scores by date.
calendar.summary: {count} relatively quiet weekdays left this month.
calendar.legendScore: pts = weather and crowd score (within the forecast)
calendar.legendHours: ~time = closing time, + = open later than usual
calendar.measuredNote: Average of the median posted wait of operating rides, recorded every 10 minutes from 10:00 to 18:00.
calendar.noForecast: Beyond the forecast range (about 9 days), so only the weekday/holiday crowd rule is shown.
calendar.method: Crowd levels are a weekday/holiday rule (Mon–Thu quieter, Friday moderate, weekends and holidays busy). Once more than four weeks of records exist, they will be replaced with measured weekday averages. Hours are park schedules collected by ThemeParks.wiki and may change, so check the official notice before you go.
